title: Isolation of human bone marrow stromal cells for single-cell RNA sequencing
author: Gleitz, Snoeren, et al.
materials: Countess II FL Automated Cell Counter
5 mL Falcon® Round-Bottom Tube with Cell Strainer Cap

Timing: 20 min1.See Materials & Equipment for preparation of the Cell Isolation buffer, Collagenase II solution, antibody mastermix and sorting buffer. Ensure that all solutions are kept on ice or at 4°C until use.2.Cool a centrifuge set up for 50 mL Falcon tubes, such as the Thermo Scientific™ Sorvall™ Legend™ XT, down to 4°C.3.Warm a shaking incubator to 37°C.Alternatives: a water bath set to 37°C can also be used, provided there is gentle agitation of the sample.

steps.title: Prepare buffers and reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare Cell Isolation buffer, Collagenase II solution, antibody master mix and sorting buffer as described in Materials & Equipment; keep all solutions on ice or at 4 °C. Cool a centrifuge for 50 mL Falcon tubes to 4 °C and warm a shaking incubator (or water bath) to 37 °C.

steps.title: Sterilize workspace and equipment
steps.instruction: Wipe the biosafety cabinet, pipettes and tweezers with 70 % ethanol. Clean a mortar and pestle with 70 % ethanol, air‑dry ~5 min, then rinse with sterile PBS just before use.

steps.title: Flush and crush biopsy (Flush/Crush fraction)
steps.instruction: Place a 70 µm cell strainer over a 50 mL Falcon tube. Using a 1 mL insulin syringe or P1000 tip, flush the trephine biopsy with 1 mL Cell Isolation buffer (PBS + 2 % FBS) through the strainer into the tube; repeat twice (total 3 mL). Transfer the biopsy to the cleaned mortar, add 5 mL Cell Isolation buffer, and gently crush with the pestle, tapping to release cells. Transfer the ~5 mL buffer through the same 70 µm strainer into the tube containing the flushed fraction. Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and gently resuspend the pellet in 300 µL Cell Isolation buffer. Keep this tube on ice.

steps.title: Collect bone chip fraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the remaining bone fragments (bone chips) from the mortar into a second sterile 50 mL Falcon tube (Bone Chip Fraction). Rinse the mortar and the previously used cell strainer with 10 mL Collagenase II solution and add this rinse to the Bone Chip Fraction tube.

steps.title: Collagenase digestion of bone chips
steps.instruction: Seal the Bone Chip Fraction tube with Parafilm. Incubate in the pre‑warmed shaking incubator for 90 min at 37 °C with gentle agitation. After digestion, let the chips settle, then carefully transfer the supernatant through a 70 µm strainer into a new 50 mL Falcon tube. Wash the remaining chips with 10 mL Cell Isolation buffer, collect the wash supernatant through the strainer and combine with the previous supernatant; repeat the wash once more. Centrifuge the combined supernatants at 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Combine cell suspensions
steps.instruction: Add the cell pellet from the Flush/Crush fraction (step 3) to the tube containing the digested bone‑chip cells. Optional: count cells and assess viability with Trypan Blue and an automated cell counter (aim for >60 % live cells).

steps.title: Stain cells for FACS
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the combined suspension at 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C and discard supernatant. Resuspend the pellet in 110 µL Cell Isolation buffer. Aliquot 10 µL into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube and add 290 µL buffer (unstained control). To the remaining 100 µL, add 5 µL antibody master mix, mix gently and incubate 20 min at 4 °C in the dark. Wash the stained cells with 1 mL Cell Isolation buffer, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 300 µL Cell Isolation buffer. Pass the suspension through a 5 mL Falcon® round‑bottom tube equipped with a 35 µm nylon mesh cap to remove aggregates. Keep samples at 4 °C in the dark; they should be processed for FACS within 4 h (ideally sooner).

steps.title: Prepare sorting buffer aliquots
steps.instruction: Aliquot 300 µL sorting buffer (DMEM + 10 % FBS) into 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes and store on ice until the FACS sort. The stained cells may be held on ice in the dark for up to 4 h before sorting.
